name: Painted Tree Boutiques - Cinco Ranch
summary: Painted Tree Boutiques - Cinco Ranch is a unique shopping destination featuring hundreds of independent boutique shops under one roof, specializing in home decor, fashion, and gifts. This community-focused marketplace has earned "Best of the Best" recognition annually since 2016, offering shoppers a curated selection of one-of-a-kind items from local entrepreneurs and artisans.
demographics: Painted Tree Boutiques - Cinco Ranch attracts a predominantly female demographic of middle to upper-middle income shoppers, typically aged 25-65, who appreciate unique, artisan-made goods and support local entrepreneurs. The Cinco Ranch area of Katy, TX is characterized by affluent suburban families with household incomes well above the national average, living in master-planned communities. Shoppers here seek one-of-a-kind home decor, fashion, and gifts rather than mass-market merchandise, with a preference for boutique-style shopping experiences that offer personalized service and curated selections.
description: Painted Tree Boutiques - Cinco Ranch offers a revolutionary shopping concept that brings together hundreds of independent shop owners under one roof, creating a vibrant marketplace of unique treasures. Located at 6729 South Fry Road in the affluent Cinco Ranch area of Katy, Texas, this boutique collective has been recognized as "Best of the Best" every year since 2016 by thousands of happy shoppers. The center specializes in three main categories: home decor to make your house a home, fashion items available to try on now, and the perfect gifts for any occasion. What sets Painted Tree apart is its community-focused approach, where local entrepreneurs and artisans can thrive in individual shop spaces while benefiting from shared resources and a supportive team environment. Throughout the year, the center hosts exciting events including festive holiday gatherings, creative workshops, and ladies' nights that bring the community together and showcase the talents of their vendors. The staff fosters a culture of togetherness, supporting local small businesses while providing shoppers with a treasure trove of lovely, inspiring, and stylish items. With operating hours from 10 AM to 8 PM daily and a stellar 4.5-star rating from over 257 reviews, Painted Tree Boutiques has become a destination where shoppers can explore, discover, and adore unique finds around every corner.
